root_idea.summary: The root centers on strength, firmness, and correspondence with reality, especially in speech and conduct.
root_idea.development: The underlying image is of something firm or sound. From this develop truthfulness, confirmation, faithful fulfillment, sound or honorable quality, charity as a sincere act, and related meanings of friendship and dowry as an obligatory due.

senses.definition: To speak, report, or state truthfully; to be true or correct in what is said, promised, or believed.
senses.usage_conditions: May be intransitive or take a person, report, promise, or other information as its object. The truth may concern speech, a promise, or the correctness of an opinion.

senses.definition: To prove true or fulfill what was promised or undertaken, especially by faithful action.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of fulfilling a covenant, promise, or divinely given assurance, and of conduct that realizes what has been professed.

senses.definition: To declare someone or something truthful; to accept, admit, or believe a report or claim as true.
senses.usage_conditions: May take a person, statement, report, or proposition as its object, with the sense of holding it or its speaker to be truthful.

senses.definition: To confirm, verify, or establish the truth of something, including by corresponding action.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of confirming a report, prior revelation, opinion, or promise, and of proving truth through conduct or fulfillment.

senses.definition: To give charity or alms.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic usage explicitly discussed for صَدَّقَ, distinct from the ordinary Form II senses of accepting or confirming truth.

senses.definition: To give charity or alms.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of giving property or another benefit as ṣadaqah, including a request to confer such a gift.

senses.definition: To relinquish a due, claim, retaliation, or other right as a charitable remission.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a right or financial obligation that its holder forgoes; the act is treated as charity.

senses.definition: Truer or more truthful.
senses.usage_conditions: A comparative adjective used to compare the truthfulness or veracity of persons, statements, or claims.

senses.definition: Truthful, veracious, or true in speech and assertion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or substantively of people and of what is said or claimed; inflectional gender and number do not create separate lexical senses.

senses.definition: A charitable gift or alms given for God's sake; charity.
senses.usage_conditions: Primarily denotes voluntary giving, but may also designate obligatory alms when given as an act of faithful obedience; its plural is صَدَقَات.

senses.definition: A friend, especially a true or sincere friend.
senses.usage_conditions: Can refer to one friend or, by usage, to more than one person; the Quranic occurrences use the ordinary friendship sense.

senses.definition: The dowry or nuptial gift given to a bride.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural form صَدُقَات is a variant of the noun صَدَاق and denotes the bridal gifts owed to women.

senses.definition: Truth, veracity, or truthful integrity: agreement among what is said, what is believed, and what is real.
senses.usage_conditions: May extend from truthful speech to truth realized in conduct, fidelity, and fulfillment.

senses.definition: Sound, good, honorable, or worthy quality.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used in qualifying constructions to denote a favorable or excellent place, position, mention, entry, or exit, rather than merely truth in a statement.

senses.definition: One exceptionally or habitually truthful; one who consistently affirms truth and realizes it in action.
senses.usage_conditions: An intensive personal designation, stronger than ordinary صَادِق; it may include truth in speech, belief, confirmation, and conduct.

senses.definition: A woman exceptionally or habitually truthful, affirming truth, and embodying it in conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine counterpart of صِدِّيق, used as an intensive personal designation.

senses.definition: Accepting, admitting, or holding a person, report, or claim to be true.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of Form II; the object may be a speaker or what has been said.

senses.definition: Confirming or verifying the truth of something, especially by correspondence with or attestation of an earlier message.
senses.usage_conditions: Frequently used of a later scripture or message confirming what preceded it; it may also describe proof or action that establishes truth.

senses.definition: One who gives charity or alms.
senses.usage_conditions: The assimilated Quranic spellings مُصَّدِّق and its inflected forms are pronunciation variants of مُتَصَدِّق, not the Form II confirmer مُصَدِّق.

senses.definition: Confirmation, verification, or the establishing of truth.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of Form II, including confirmation of a prior message or realization of a claim in fact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render advice or brotherly affection sincerely, and to act with genuine earnestness toward another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with advice, counsel, or affection; this is a broader Classical usage distinct from simply stating a true report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shine clearly, of the dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's own soul to tell one the truth by restraining or holding one back from an undertaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic expression describing an inner realization of inability or unsuitability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wild animal, to run straight on without looking aside when charged or attacked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exact or collect the poor-rate from people or their livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized administrative or fiscal usage, distinct from accepting or confirming truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To associate with someone as a friend or as a true, sincere friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or relational verb of forming friendship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To name, assign, give, or make payable a dowry; to marry a woman with a specified nuptial gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes the woman and/or the dowry as objects in the relevant constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who asks or begs for charity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A disputed Classical usage: some authorities report it, while other grammarians reject calling a beggar مُتَصَدِّق and restrict the word to the giver.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act as sincere friends toward one another, or to be mutually truthful and sincere in speech and affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction, contrasted with mutual falsehood or insincerity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard, straight, firm, or complete and excellent; by extension, a person or thing possessing commendable strength or quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a spear, sword, person, or other praised thing; related expressions describe steadfastness or earnestness in encounter and look.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very or eminently truthful and veracious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective for a high degree of habitual truthfulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Friendship, affection, or sincere firmness of heart in love.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exclusively human relational quality in the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Earnest or genuine, especially of a charge or assault made without a false show of bravery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression for a serious, committed attack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely or genuinely sweet, of dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement or intense, of cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective used with cold weather or sensation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A star, identified variously as a small star near the stars of Ursa Major or as the pole-star; it is also reported as an epithet meaning trusted, and by some as meaning king.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The star identification is lexically disputed in the cited material, as are the additional epithet senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom فِي غِبِّ صَادِقَةٍ, after the matter has become manifest or clear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic expression, not the ordinary personal adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Earnestness or courage in a charge; of a horse, vigorous and excellent running; and of an opinion, truth or sincerity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing a courageous man, a fleet horse, or an opinion that proves true.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hardness, or the edge of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Specialized nominal usages reported separately from the expressions of earnest performance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person from whom the poor-rate of livestock is exacted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial fiscal designation, distinct from مُصَدِّق, the collector.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The collector or exactor of the alms-dues or poor-rate owed on livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized administrative noun for the person collecting the due from cattle, sheep, goats, or camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that confirms or proves the truth of another thing; evidence or a manifestation of a person's truthfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a confirming fact, proof, or outward evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Earnestness attributable to a charge or assault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in a fixed expression contrasting a genuine charge with a merely feigned one.

cautions: The Quranic spellings مُصَّدِّق and related forms in the charity contexts are assimilated pronunciations of مُتَصَدِّق; they are not the confirmer مُصَدِّق.
The begging sense of مُتَصَدِّق is disputed in the Classical evidence and is not used for the Quranic form.

Some Lane Quran citations occur in historical or variant-reading discussions without an independently secure QAC location for that particular reading; they are represented lexically without inventing modern verse locations.
